findlay-market: For an order paid with SNAP benefits, the service FAQ requires the cardholder to be present with the physical EBT card and a valid state ID or passport. A friend or family member cannot simply accept the SNAP order instead.

Can a friend, family member, or significant-other accept my order on my behalf? The SNAP Benefits cardholder must be present with the physical EBT card and a valid state ID or passport in order to complete the transaction.

If pickup timing, the date or the delivery method needs to change, the shopping service asks customers to call or text 513-744-8010 or email shoppingapp@findlaymarket.org. The FAQ offers to work with customers; a particular change is not guaranteed.

Can I modify my pickup time, date or delivery method? Yes. We are happy to work with you to adjust your retrieval method. Please call or text (513) 744-8010 or email shoppingapp@findlaymarket.org with any request.

The shopping FAQ sets the cancellation cutoff at 5 p.m. the night before fulfillment. If unable to collect an order, contact the service to arrange another pickup; abandoned orders are charged in full and may incur additional fees.

What happens if I need to cancel an order? The cutoff time for cancellations is 5pm, the night before your fulfillment day to allow for ample time to make adjustments with our many local merchants. Please call or text (513) 744-8010 or email shoppingapp@findlaymarket.org if you need to cancel.

What happens if I am unable to pick up my order? Please call or text (513) 744-8010 or email shoppingapp@findlaymarket.org to make other pickup arrangements. All customers who abandon orders will be charged for the entirety of their order and may additionally be charged with incidental fees or charges.

For driver-licensing appointments, KYTC allows phone check-in and waiting in a car or inside until a text calls the customer. Without a mobile device, check in at an indoor kiosk or with staff and wait in the lobby. These are regional-office procedures, not a promise of curbside service or an elevator route.

On the day of your appointment, you’ll receive a text message with check-in instructions. You can check in on your phone and wait in your car or inside the office until you receive a text letting you know it is your turn.
